# Parked at clarify until SEEN-006 delivers

Decision by the founder, 23 September 2026: SEEN-089 waits for the monorepo rather than being split
or built against stubs. Its declared dependency is real, and three of its five acceptance criteria
have nothing to run against until `packages/core` exists.

The journal stops here at the clarify stage. Resuming needs no context beyond these two records:
`harness status SEEN-089` will say clarify, and the note at record 2 lists what is buildable today
and what is not.

The carried-in work from SEEN-087 and SEEN-088 travels with this ticket: refuse a delivery whose
checks are not green on the delivered commit, and compare the receipt's commit to the branch tip at
merge. Two defects have already escaped receipts for want of it.
